MRI Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5T only): SFG ≤ 2,500 gauss/cm (25 T/m); slew rate ≤ 150 T/m/s per axis; whole-body averaged SAR of 4 W/kg or less; First Level Controlled Operating Mode; No more than 20 minutes of active scan time per session.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
